test_plan.strategy: Three layers — unit (collectors, breaker, aggregator, validators), integration (SQLite store + restart, helper allow-list, alert engine wiring, SSE), e2e (Playwright against the running Ultron-AP binary on a Pi-class harness with FR-007 session cookie). All probes use injectable Clock and a fake transport in unit tests; integration uses a temp SQLite file via os.tmpdir(); e2e runs against a Vagrant-Pi harness with a controlled fault injector (`scripts/netfault.sh` blocks a target via iptables).

test_cases.title: ICMP probe — 5 minutes of samples produce rtt/jitter/loss for each target
preconditions: Default targets seeded: gateway, 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, configured DNS
test_cases.given: internal/network started 5 minutes ago with default 4 targets and cadence_s=10; control transport always returns rtt=12.0±1.5 ms
test_cases.when: GET /api/network/probes with a valid session cookie
test_cases.then: HTTP 200, JSON array length=4, each item has rtt_ms in [10.0,14.0], jitter_ms in [0.5,3.0], loss_pct=0.0, status='ok', ts within last 15 s
steps: Boot service with seeded targets and fake ICMP transport
Advance fake clock 5 minutes feeding 30 samples per target
Assert response shape and value bounds
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 200; rtt_ms within [10,14], jitter_ms within [0.5,3], loss_pct=0.0, status='ok' for all 4 targets

test_cases.then: GET /api/network/probes returns the target with loss_pct=100.0 and status='timeout'; SELECT FROM net_events WHERE kind='target_unreachable' returns ≥1 row referencing host=10.255.255.1
steps: Run worker for 35 s under fake clock
test_cases.expected_result: API: loss_pct=100.0, status='timeout'. DB: ≥1 net_events row kind='target_unreachable' with payload_json containing the target host.

test_cases.expected_result: 5 intervals all within [54,66] s; mean within [58.5,61.5] s.
